notes: Expanded FEAT-3 story set to full backend slice including schema, core logic, API integration, tests, and external API handling.

FEAT-3-S85.title: Clinical Trials Input/Output Schema Definition
FEAT-3-S85.description: Define and validate Pydantic models for clinical trials search inputs and normalized outputs including condition, location, recruiting status, and travel distance fields to ensure strict contract between tool router and domain service.

FEAT-3-S86.title: ClinicalTrials.gov Search Core Logic
FEAT-3-S86.description: Implement core domain logic to query ClinicalTrials.gov API with recruiting filter, parse results, and extract structured trial metadata including locations and eligibility indicators.

FEAT-3-S87.title: Travel Distance and Duration Computation
FEAT-3-S87.description: Integrate Google Routes API within clinical trials service to compute travel distance and duration from user location to trial sites and append results to trial records.

FEAT-3-S88.title: Clinical Trials API Exposure via Facade
FEAT-3-S88.description: Expose clinical trials search capability through EvaluateCare facade, ensuring orchestration of schema validation, service invocation, and response formatting for tool router consumption.

FEAT-3-S89.title: Clinical Trials Service Unit and Integration Tests
FEAT-3-S89.description: Create unit and integration tests covering ClinicalTrials.gov query handling, recruiting filter enforcement, travel distance computation, and error handling for external API failures.
FEAT-3-S89.evidence: GAP: No existing clinical trials test file found in backend/tests; must create new test module for clinical trials service

FEAT-3.mitigation: Reuse existing clinical_trials_service implementation and constrain to recruiting filter already implemented.
